Embedded Software Engineer I (Onsite)

Full-time
Onsite

RTX is hiring an Embedded Software Engineer I for its Secure Product Assurance/Sensors Space and Air Software team at Raytheon. The role designs, develops, integrates, and tests real-time embedded software for defense applications, including next-generation radar, sensor, guidance, fire control, and electronic warfare systems.

Responsibilities
Work on complex technical problems and collaborate to provide innovative solutions. Requires investigation and troubleshooting skills to assess issues and develop resolutions
Work at all phases of the SW development lifecycle, including SW/HW integration, dependent on program phase
Assist in the derivation of system and software requirements, architectural modeling, and technical analysis
Design, code, unit test, integrate, and document real-time embedded software solutions with a focus on Electronic Warfare implementations
Participate actively in software peer reviews, code inspections, and technical decision-making alongside multidisciplinary teams, including program leadership and customers
Support program execution to ensure work products meet technical, cost, schedule, and quality baselines
Follow established software development processes and practices to maintain software product integrity

Required
The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
Bachelors degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from an accredited institution. Degree must be obtained by start date
Experience developing, and testing or debugging software using C, C++, or similar object-oriented programming language
Strong Object-Oriented Design knowledge and real time embedded software development experience
Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving experience
Experience developing software in a team-based development environment with strong teamwork and communication skills
Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects
Preferred
Knowledge of Software Development Processes and experience participating in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, implementation, and testing
Experience working with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and automated build environments
Familiarity with Scrum/Agile, DevSecOps, Git/GitLab
Hardware / software integration experience
Interfacing with FPGAs
Development experience working on Redhat Linux, VxWorks, Green Hills or other Real Time Operating Systems
Inter-processor communication
X-86 and ARM Architectures
Experience working in lab environments with physical hardware (e.g., test benches, simulators)
Practical exposure to radar technologies, radar signal processing, or RF or Electronic Warfare systems
Modeling and Simulation knowledge
Hands-on experience developing low-level device drivers or real-time embedded operating system (RTOS) applications
Benefits
Relocation eligible.
Hired applicants may be eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability; 401(k) match; flexible spending accounts; flexible work schedules; employee assistance program; Employee Scholar Program; parental leave; paid time off; and holidays. Specific benefits depend on the business unit and whether the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.
Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the position level and whether the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments are not guaranteed and depend on factors including individual, business unit, and/or company performance.
